title: Sprint 2 Epic — Runnable Multi-Language Examples
description: For every construct in the library, generate runnable CDK app examples in all 5 JSII languages (TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Go) that exercise all inputs and all divergent behavioral scenarios. Examples are co-located in packages/<construct>/examples/<scenario>/. Each example ships with a cdk.json fixture referencing the shared CDK Bridge JSON. All examples must pass `cdk synth`. CDK assertion tests validate CloudFormation output in the construct existing test/ dir. README for each construct is updated to link to examples.

comments.author: lead-engineer
comments.body: Sprint 2 complete: all 26 construct example tasks merged to develop across all 5 JSII languages
